title: European Resuscitation Council Guidelines 2021
claims: The 2021 ERC guidelines set out the European approach to basic life support and the chain of survival.
They emphasise early recognition, calling emergency services and early defibrillation by bystanders.
They describe dispatch centres as able to guide callers through recognition and immediate response.
